messages:
arpit: kicking off a compact rollout for feature flag `ff.dynamic_cache` (llm-route cache tuning) — plan: 0% -> 2% over 10m, canary region: ap-south. deploy-bot: rollout started id=rb-5924 (link: https://releases/internal/rb-5924)

morgan: ack. claire — can you pin apac-east to stable v1 for 45m while we watch? want to avoid impacting APAC customers.

claire: running pin now: `deploy-bot pin-cohort --cohort=apac-east --service=llm-route --version=v1 --ttl=45m`
deploy-bot: cohort pin applied (pin_id=pin-592A)

ops: dashboards prepped: p50/p95 latency, 5xx-rate, cache-eviction-rate, memory-growth. alert thresholds: 5xx>0.6% or eviction-rate>1.2%

release-bot: release-note draft auto-generated for rb-5924. please edit before merge.

arpit: starting the ramp now. deploy-bot: traffic -> 2% (canary: ap-south)

morgan: seeing a small bump in 503s in canary at 03:12 UTC, 0.15% -> 0.9% in 6m. eviction-rate also spiked.

arpit: pausing rollout. deploy-bot: pause rb-5924 (reason: canary 5xx + eviction spike reported)

claire: pulling traces — looks like cache-eviction storms when requests include multi-turn contexts >800 tokens; memory churn causes backend worker restarts on new dynamic-cache path.

morgan: proposal: drain canary workers and fallback canary traffic to v1 while we triage; keep apac-east pin in place. partial rollback for canary only?

arpit: do it. deploy-bot: partial rollback rb-5924 -> revert canary subset to v1
deploy-bot: partial rollback complete (rb-5924) — canary cohort reverted to v1, global ramp cleared

ops: pin-592A remains active for apac-east. leaving it until we have a validated fix.

release-bot: updating release-note: "mini rollout paused — cache eviction regression under long-context requests; canary rolled back to v1; apac-east pinned to v1 while we investigate."

claire: opening perf bug with traces and memory/eviction timelines. initial hypothesis: dynamic cache eviction policy is too aggressive for long multi-turn sessions on quantized path.

arpit: next steps: claire to file ISSUE-7781 with repro and traces, morgan to schedule a tighter experiment after fix (0.5% traffic, max_context=512), ops to prep customer comms if we see expanded impact. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: ticket updated: https://issues/internal/ISSUE-7781 (status: investigating)

morgan: ping me on the ticket when there's a candidate patch and a smoke-run plan.

arpit: thanks all. closing this thread and moving follow-ups into ISSUE-7781.
